messages.subject: JavaScript and Shiny Interaction
parts:
I am relatively new to Shiny, but I adore it!  I am hoping this group can help me answer a question I am having major trouble with.  I have used R for years but just started looking at JavaScript.  I have these two functions:

<script>
  // UPDATE TO USE YOUR PROJECT ID AND CLIENT ID
var project_id = String(document.getElementsByClassName('ProjectID')[0].value);
var client_id = String(document.getElementsByClassName('ClientID')[0].value);

var config = {
  'client_id': client_id,
  'scope': 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/plus.login https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email https://www.googleapis.com/auth/bigquery'
};

function runQuery() {
  var request = gapi.client.bigquery.jobs.query({
    'projectId': project_id,
    'timeoutMs': '30000',
    'query': 'SELECT ActionGeo_Lat,ActionGeo_Long, ActionGeo_FullName,SQLDATE, EventCode,SOURCEURL,AvgTone,Actor1Name,Actor2Name,NumArticles, GLOBALEVENTID FROM [gdelt-bq:full.events] WHERE (REGEXP_MATCH(EventCode, "'+ String(document.getElementsByClassName('Event')[0].value) + '" )) AND Actor1Code CONTAINS "' + String(document.getElementsByClassName('Country')[0].value) +'"AND (SQLDATE >' + String(document.getElementsByClassName('dates')[0].value).replace('/-', '') + 'AND (SQLDATE < ' + String(document.getElementsByClassName('dates')[1].value).replace('/-', '') + ') GROUP BY SQLDATE,ActionGeo_FullName,ActionGeo_Lat,ActionGeo_Long,EventCode,SOURCEURL,AvgTone,Actor1Name,Actor2Name,NumArticles, GLOBALEVENTID;'
  });
  request.execute(function(response) {     
    console.log(response)  
  });
}

function auth() {
  gapi.auth.authorize(config, function() {
    gapi.client.load('bigquery', 'v2', runQuery);
    $('#client_initiated').html('BigQuery client initiated');
  });
  $('#auth_button').hide();
}

Where I have the document.getElementsByClassName commands, I need to be able to accept user input via both drop down menus (Event, Country) and text input boxes(ProjectID, ClientID, and dates).  I know these functions work when I brute force it, so it's not the javascript.  Any advice you can give would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks so much for creating Shiny!
